Hi Samantha —

Thanks for registering for our 'Serving LLMs in Production' webinar this morning. I’m Dylan on the SDR team at Redwood Inference — glad you could join. A few attendees asked for a quick product walkthrough showing latency/cost controls and how Dedicated capacity works; I wanted to see if a 25–30 minute demo would make sense for your team.

If so, here are a few slots I have this week and early next week (all PT):
- Thu 9/2: 11:00am–11:30am or 3:30pm–4:00pm
- Fri 9/3: 10:00am–10:30am
- Mon 9/6: 2:00pm–2:30pm

If none of those work, happy to send a Calendly link or loop in one of our AEs to find a time that fits your schedule. If useful, what’s a quick note on what you’d like to see (e.g., pricing, dedicated/private deployment, or a live load test)?
